nodes.label: eps-transact-mcp VM deployment runbook
nodes.rationale: Deployed to /data/eps-mcp on a SHARED Azure RHEL prod box that also runs the ems container and connect.eko.in nginx; service binds 127.0.0.1:8788 only and is never exposed directly.

nodes.label: mcp.eko.in path namespace contract (/transact/, /context/ reserved)
nodes.rationale: Permanent path-namespacing so a future edge-hosted eps-context-mcp can live at /context/mcp; bare / returns 404 to keep the namespace reserved.

nodes.label: nginx reverse-proxy config (X-Real-IP, no buffering, TLS)
nodes.rationale: X-Real-IP MUST be overwritten because the rate-limit IP fallback trusts it; buffering is off both directions for streamable HTTP; the trailing slash on proxy_pass strips the /transact/ prefix, safe only because the app emits no absolute URLs or redirects.

nodes.label: GHCR authentication (private images, .ghcr-auth.json)
nodes.rationale: The 'public poller image' claim in the old doc was wrong — images are private. The host daemon needs docker login AND the poller separately needs its own .ghcr-auth.json for skopeo digest checks.

nodes.label: Docker data-root on /data pinned to the vfs driver
nodes.rationale: A fresh /data/docker on ext4 made Docker auto-pick overlay2 and ignore the rsynced vfs data, making ems vanish; pinning storage-driver: vfs recovers it and avoids recreating ems's unscripted docker run config. vfs is slow and bloats, so a weekly image prune cron was added.

nodes.label: GHCR digest poller auto-deploy with health gate + rollback
nodes.rationale: Polls the :prod digest, pulls on change, rewrites the deploy.env pin, recreates the service, gates on /healthz, and auto-rolls-back to last-good with a HOLD state to stop flapping. Requires Compose v2 at runtime because it shells out to `docker compose`.

nodes.label: Certbot renewal timer gotcha
nodes.rationale: After `certbot --nginx` no renewal timer existed and had to be enabled explicitly; a failing dry-run was a transient network blip, not an nginx/redirect problem. Firewalld ports must be verified as permanent, not just runtime.
